description:
Documentation audit (2026-04-01) found 3 critical accuracy errors that will
cause user failures if followed:

1. `docs/advanced/custom-benchmarks.md` has a Python syntax error (missing
   colon in loop statement) and calls a non-existent method
   `get_create_tables_sql("duckdb")` with a dialect parameter that doesn't
   exist in the API.

2. `docs/benchmarks/ai-primitives.md` documents a complete benchmark (16
   queries, schema, examples) that has NO implementation in the codebase.
   Users cannot run this benchmark.

3. `docs/tutorials/dataframe-quickstart.md` uses `-o` as shorthand for
   `--output`, but no such short flag exists in the CLI. Also references
   deprecated `--df-tuning` and `benchbox df-tuning` commands that should
   be `benchbox tuning`.

These are the highest-impact doc bugs because they cause immediate user
errors when following the documentation.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import ast, re, pathlib; src=pathlib.Path('docs/advanced/custom-benchmarks.md').read_text(); blocks=re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)```', src, re.S); [ast.parse(b) for b in blocks]; print('PASS: all code blocks parse')"
verifications.description: Python code blocks in custom-benchmarks.md parse without syntax errors

verifications.command: grep -n 'get_create_tables_sql.*duckdb\|get_create_tables_sql.*dialect' docs/advanced/custom-benchmarks.md || echo 'PASS: no phantom API call'
verifications.description: No reference to non-existent get_create_tables_sql dialect parameter

verifications.command: if [ ! -f docs/benchmarks/ai-primitives.md ]; then echo 'PASS: file removed'; else grep -q 'Not Yet Implemented\|not yet implemented\|Planned' docs/benchmarks/ai-primitives.md && echo 'PASS: marked as planned' || echo 'FAIL: no implementation marker'; fi
verifications.description: ai-primitives.md removed or clearly marked as not implemented

verifications.command: grep -n '\b-o\b' docs/tutorials/dataframe-quickstart.md | grep -v '\-\-o' || echo 'PASS: no bare -o flags'
verifications.description: No bare -o flags remain in dataframe quickstart

verifications.command: grep -rn 'df-tuning\|df_tuning' docs/tutorials/ || echo 'PASS: no deprecated refs'

work_units.summary: Fix syntax error and non-existent API call in custom-benchmarks.md
Remove or stub ai-primitives.md - no implementation exists
Fix incorrect -o flag and deprecated df-tuning in dataframe-quickstart.md
